findings.issue: Every changed link now carries "action": "revise". In the Drafting_Record all 19 were "action": "new", none of them is a published link (no id found outside the audit folders), and "revise" is not in the main brief's action vocabulary (keep | retype | regrade | rewrite | remove | split | new). Earlier eras' revision files keep "new" for new links. A merge that reads "revise" may look for a published link to change and either fail or drop the link. This is mechanical and changes no content, so it can be applied without re-review.
